tiers.text: The back window's latch is rotten through. Someone has painted over it twice rather than replace it.

variants.text: The rotten latch is one thing. The fence panel on the east side is another: wired on, not bolted. It would lift.

tiers.text: There's a back window that might give with enough force. May not be quiet, though.

variants.text: A fire escape runs up the depot's side wall, rust-brown and loose at the bottom rung. The back window might give as well.

physics.miss: Brick, shutters, a bolted gate. Nothing that moves.

tiers.text: One guard is flagging, eyes half shut. His flask is empty and he keeps checking it anyway.
One guard keeps shifting his weight, the way a man does at the end of a double shift.

life.miss: Four coats and a lot of breath. You can't tell who's awake.

tiers.text: The nearest guard is jumpy. He flinches at his own radio. Easy to rattle.
One guard keeps glancing at the door, then at his phone, then at the door.

emotion.miss: Flat faces, arms folded. They've done this before.

tiers.text: The patrol has a gap. You count it twice. Forty seconds, every round, like a bus timetable.

variants.text: The patrol gap is forty seconds. The camera over the door sweeps on a slower beat, and you count that too.

tiers.text: The rounds run roughly on the quarter hour. Roughly.

time.miss: You can't make out any shift or predictable patrol routes.

tiers.text: You catch the moment one guard will turn away. A second before he does it.

variants.text: You catch the moment one guard will turn away. And the camera over the door has a flicker in it, waiting to go.

tiers.text: Something is about to go wrong for someone here. Not necessarily you.

fate.miss: No chances you can see here. It's just a yard at night.

cards.label: {today} — The approach
cards.text: Nobody has put a sign on this vein, but the ground still belongs to someone. You case the approach twice. No obvious watchers. That's not the same as no watchers.
A fenced yard, a guard hut, a depot door. Three ways to start.

choices.label: Talk your way through the gate

success.result_text: You nod like someone expected. The guard checks his clipboard, finds no one, and lifts the barrier anyway.

fail.result_text: The guard wants a name, and a company. You offer neither, and he reaches for the radio.

success.result_text: Over, down, and into the dark behind the depot. The tarmac is cracked and nobody is standing on it.

fail.result_text: The wire sings as you land, one long thin note across the whole yard.

choices.label: Up the fire escape
choices.result_text: The bottom rung comes away in your hand. You go up on the others.

cards.text: What you saw buys other ways in.

success.result_text: You mention that his radio has been cutting out. He goes into the hut to check it, and the gate goes unwatched.

fail.result_text: He doesn't flinch. He does start looking at you properly.

success.result_text: The wired-on panel lifts like a lid. You set it down behind you.

fail.result_text: The wire catches your sleeve and rings along the whole fence.

success.result_text: It was never latched. Someone has been meaning to fix that since spring.

fail.result_text: It was latched. The clang carries.

cards.text: Or don't be subtle.

success.result_text: You hit the gate with your shoulder and go in. It hurts more than it should.

fail.result_text: The gate holds, then doesn't, and drops open with the sound of a bin lid on tarmac.

choices.label: Blast the gate
choices.result_text: The gate leaves its hinges in one piece and lands flat. Every head in the hut turns.

success.result_text: The yard folds, and you step out in the vein room before anyone has finished looking at the gate.

fail.result_text: The fold lands you inside, and not unseen. There is a hole in the air behind you.

cards.text: Crossing the yard under the hut window.

success.result_text: You count the gap and cross it. Forty seconds, and you use thirty-five.

fail.result_text: The round comes early. You were counting; he wasn't.

choices.label: Wait for the tired guard to nod

success.result_text: The tired guard's chin drops. You cross while he's somewhere else.

fail.result_text: He looks up, just as your shadow crosses the hut window.

success.result_text: You cross the yard with the purpose of a lanyard. Nobody asks what it's for.

fail.result_text: Someone asks for a pass. It turns out the walk doesn't count.

cards.text: Luck, or something you packed.

success.result_text: He looks away at the right moment. You cross.

fail.result_text: He doesn't look away. He's still looking when you notice.

choices.label: Prophet's Breath: know when he turns
choices.result_text: You know the second he turns. You use it.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze and rush past
choices.result_text: The yard stops. You don't.

cards.text: The depot door, and a lock.

success.result_text: The lock turns over without a sound.

fail.result_text: The pick snaps in the lock. The sound is small and carries anyway.

choices.label: Lift the keys off the hut hook

success.result_text: The keys come off the hook one at a time. The guard asleep in the chair keeps sleeping.

fail.result_text: The keys jingle. The man in the chair opens one eye.

success.result_text: It isn't locked. Whoever was last out has gone home.

fail.result_text: It is. The handle rattles under your hand.

cards.text: Doors open outward as well as inward.

choices.label: Walk in
choices.result_text: No lock. You let yourself in like a man with a delivery.

success.result_text: The door gives under your weight.

fail.result_text: The door gives, loudly, and bangs the wall behind it.

choices.label: Blast the door
choices.result_text: The door is a hole now, and the handle is somewhere in the yard.

cards.text: A back window, and the latch.

choices.label: Slide something in and lift the latch

success.result_text: The blade finds the latch and lifts it. The window slides up an inch, then more.

fail.result_text: The window shrieks in its frame, rotten wood on rusted runners.

success.result_text: It gives a little at a time, and you let it.

fail.result_text: It sticks, then gives all at once, shrieking.

choices.label: Wait for a car to backfire

success.result_text: A car backfires in the road. So does the window, underneath it.

fail.result_text: No car comes. The window is loud in a street that has gone quiet.

cards.text: The window is only glass.

success.result_text: Glass everywhere, mostly on the inside.

fail.result_text: Glass everywhere, and a shout from the yard.

choices.label: Blast it in
choices.result_text: The window is a different shape now, and so is the quiet.

cards.text: The back corridor. A guard on his round.

success.result_text: He passes. You don't move until his footsteps are gone.

fail.result_text: He turns the corner early, and you are in the middle of the corridor.

choices.label: Let the tired one drift past

success.result_text: He drifts past, half asleep on his feet, and you slip in behind him.

fail.result_text: He wasn't as tired as he looked. He stops walking.

success.result_text: He's late. You're through before he arrives.

fail.result_text: He isn't late. He's exactly on time.

cards.text: Something packed, or something blunt.

choices.label: Prophet's Breath: know where he'll be
choices.result_text: You step aside a breath before he arrives. He walks through the space you were in.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze and rush past
choices.result_text: He stops mid-step with a foot in the air. You walk round it.

choices.label: Fight through
choices.result_text: No more creeping. You step into his way.

cards.text: A fire escape up the side wall.

success.result_text: Up, rung by rung, weight on the bolts and not the rails.

fail.result_text: A rung gives with a crack. Someone in the yard looks up.

success.result_text: The rung holds. So does the one above it.

fail.result_text: It doesn't. You catch the rail and the whole stair rings.

cards.text: The skylight, and a rusted catch.

success.result_text: The catch lets go with a small flake of rust.

fail.result_text: The catch screams, rust on rust, and the sound is all yours.

success.result_text: It lets go on the first push.

fail.result_text: It doesn't. It does make a noise about it.

choices.label: Blast the skylight
choices.result_text: The skylight is not a skylight any more, only a frame with some glass left in it.

cards.text: A drop into the vein room, and a guard below.

choices.label: Wait for him to look away

success.result_text: He turns to the door. You drop.

fail.result_text: He doesn't turn. You hang there, and the time for waiting runs out.

success.result_text: He does. You drop.

fail.result_text: He doesn't, and you run out of reasons to wait.

choices.label: Prophet's Breath: know when he turns
choices.result_text: You drop on the exact breath he turns.

cards.text: Freeze the room, or give up on it.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze him
choices.result_text: He stops mid-turn. You drop beside him.

cards.text: You could still walk away.

success.result_text: You run, and nobody catches you.

fail.result_text: They cut you off at the gate.

success.result_text: The fold takes you out and sets you down on a pavement a street away.

fail.result_text: The fold lands short, in the yard, in front of the hut.

cards.text: A shape in the hut window, turning towards you.
Footsteps on the tarmac behind you, and a torch that finds your coat.
A door opens down the corridor and the light behind it falls on you.
A guard across the yard has seen you. He reaches for his radio slowly, like a man who would rather not.

choices.label: Take him down
choices.result_text: Quick, and not quiet. He's down before the radio is up.

success.result_text: He goes back to his post, none the wiser.

fail.result_text: He doesn't buy it. He shouts.

success.result_text: You're gone before he looks.

fail.result_text: He sees where you went.

cards.text: Something packed, or the road home.

choices.label: Pan's Rapture
choices.result_text: He smiles at nothing and wanders off.

choices.label: Blast him
choices.result_text: One bang. He doesn't get up fast.

cards.text: A guard inside has seen you. He's put his tea down, which is how you know he means it.

choices.label: Take him down
choices.result_text: Quick, and not quiet. The wall helps him less than it helps you.

success.result_text: He goes back to his rounds, none the wiser.

fail.result_text: He doesn't buy it. He shouts, and the corridor carries it.

success.result_text: You're gone before the torch finds you.

fail.result_text: He sees where you went.

cards.text: Something packed, or the road home.

choices.label: Pan's Rapture
choices.result_text: He smiles at nothing and wanders off down the corridor.

choices.label: Blast him
choices.result_text: One bang, indoors. He doesn't get up fast.

cards.text: The place is awake and looking: torches in the yard, doors banging, voices that aren't bothering to whisper.

success.result_text: They pass your hiding place, close enough to smell the tea.

fail.result_text: They find you.

success.result_text: They half believe you. Half is enough.

fail.result_text: They don't.

choices.label: Pan's Rapture
choices.result_text: They smile at nothing and let the search go.

cards.text: Scare them off, or leave.

choices.label: Panic
choices.result_text: Two of them run. The rest don't know why.

cards.text: The guards in the hut stand between you and the way on.

choices.label: Fight
choices.result_text: No more subtlety. They come out of the hut together.

success.result_text: They let you by. Nobody wants to be the one who stopped the wrong person.

fail.result_text: They don't.

cards.text: Something packed.

choices.label: Prophet's Breath: skip the post
choices.result_text: You know where each of them will be, and you aren't there.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze and rush past
choices.result_text: They freeze. You don't.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze the line guard
choices.result_text: One of them stops. The fight is shorter.

cards.text: Something that makes a post lose its head.

choices.label: Pandemonium
choices.result_text: A word in the wrong ear, and the post turns on itself.

choices.label: Panic
choices.result_text: Two of them run.

choices.label: Pan's Rapture
choices.result_text: They go docile, and stay that way.

cards.text: More of them arrive from the road, in coats, already out of breath.
The raid goes on.
You keep moving.
The depot floor: pallets, strip lights, a smell of diesel and old tea.
The back of the depot: shelving, a long corridor, a door at the far end.
A camera over the door, sweeping slowly. The red light never goes out.

success.result_text: You go under it between sweeps.

fail.result_text: The camera has you. Somewhere a small light changes colour.

success.result_text: The blind spot is where you are.

fail.result_text: It isn't blind enough.

success.result_text: It's on the blink. The lens flickers and goes dark for just long enough.

fail.result_text: It isn't. The red light never wavers.

cards.text: A camera is a system. It can't be talked round.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze it
choices.result_text: The camera stops. So does the light in it.

choices.label: Blast it
choices.result_text: The camera is no longer a camera. It is a lot of small parts on the floor.

cards.text: Someone will be looking at the screen by now, and walking this way.

choices.label: Take him down
choices.result_text: He arrives. You're ready.

success.result_text: Gone by the time he arrives.

fail.result_text: He arrives early.

choices.label: Blast him
choices.result_text: One bang.

cards.text: The vein-room door, at the end of the corridor.
A ward on the threshold, faint as a draught.

choices.label: Step through
choices.result_text: You step through. The air rings once.

success.result_text: Through the gap in it.

fail.result_text: It notices.

success.result_text: It spends itself on the decoy. You wait, then go.

fail.result_text: It ignores the decoy and takes you.

cards.text: Something packed, or someone else.

success.result_text: He steps through it. You step round him.

fail.result_text: He doesn't fall for it. The ward falls for you.

choices.label: Powder past it
choices.result_text: Faster than it can notice.

success.result_text: The ward is on the other side of you.

fail.result_text: The fold lands short.

cards.text: A ward is a system. Stop it.

choices.label: Time Pearl: freeze the ward
choices.result_text: The ward stops. You don't.

cards.text: The vein room: low light, a hum in the floor, and guards standing on the vein.

choices.label: Fight for the room
choices.result_text: They don't give it up.

choices.label: Walk to the vein
choices.result_text: Nobody stops you.

success.result_text: They let you by.

fail.result_text: They don't.

choices.result_text: You know where each of them will be.

cards.text: The vein runs under the floor here, warm through your shoes.
Boots in the corridor. They're nearly here.

choices.label: Reach for the vein
choices.result_text: You reach for the vein with the footsteps getting louder.

cards.text: The vein's yours to deal with, however you got here.

choices.label: Claim it
choices.result_text: You take it outright. Word gets round fast — it always does — and the relationship with whoever ran this patch takes the hit that comes with being seen to do it.

choices.label: Loot and leave
choices.result_text: You take what you can carry and leave the rest where it stands. Someone else's problem, still.
